data.name: Rishit
data.gender_notes: Rishit is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Rishit is recorded with the meaning “Lord of the senses”. Rishit is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lord of the senses”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rishit expresses “Lord of the senses”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is like a sage or spiritual seeker

in_marathi.name: Rishit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the senses
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rishit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from two words - 'Rishi' (sage) and 'it' (one who has mastered), Rishit signifies a person who has mastered his senses.

in_bengali.name: Rishit
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the senses
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rishit একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from two words - 'Rishi' (sage) and 'it' (one who has mastered), Rishit signifies a person who has mastered his senses.
